content: GitHub Actions Android CI: use ubuntu-latest (Android SDK preinstalled at ANDROID_SDK_ROOT). JDK 17 matches project. actions/setup-java@v5 with temurin, gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6 with cache-provider basic for OSS, cache-read-only on non-main branches. Run ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lint --no-daemon. setup-gradle validates wrapper and handles caching; no android-actions/setup-android needed on hosted runners unless specific SDK packages missing.
